<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum, the chemical shift values are: 167.15, 143.85, 130.30, 34.53 (appears twice), 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. The duplicate 34.53 ppm indicates two equivalent carbons. Counting each distinct shift gives 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
